title: BlablaLib
description: This library add a simple dialogue system.
body:
# Blabla Lib This library add a dialogue system.
This is not a mod that adds anything by itself.
You can use commands like `/dialogue play` and `/dialogue set my_mod:my_cool_dialogue` to use this library.
You can also use the `BlablaLib.OpenDialogue()` function.

[More info on our github page](https://github.com/GCJOJO/BlablaLib/blob/dev/README.md)
